# `ResourceVisibilityInterface`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Visibility\ResourceVisibilityInterface`

**Interface** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/Visibility/ResourceVisibilityInterface.php)

Per-session resource visibility: filters resources/list and
resources/templates/list AND fail-closed guards resources/read — a hidden
resource (or any URI matching a hidden template) cannot be read even by
its exact URI (it is reported as not found, indistinguishable from a
missing one). One implementation serves both paths so list and read can
never disagree.

## Methods

### isVisible()

```php
isVisible(
    Mcp\Schema\ResourceDefinition $resource,
    ?Mcp\Server\Session\SessionInterface $session,
): bool
```

### isTemplateVisible()

```php
isTemplateVisible(
    Mcp\Schema\ResourceTemplate $template,
    ?Mcp\Server\Session\SessionInterface $session,
): bool
```
